title: SENARA UMKM Business Toolkit
tagline: A point-of-sale, inventory, and pricing system built inside Google Sheets — designed so a small shop owner who's never touched a spreadsheet formula can run their daily business from it.
problem: Small business owners frequently struggle to track real profit margins because unit pricing is determined by guesswork, and manual cash flow tracking easily breaks when multiple staff members handle inventory.
solution: An integrated point-of-sale register, automated cost-to-price margin calculator (HPP), and real-time profit & loss dashboard built entirely inside Google Sheets without requiring external apps or subscription fees.
results: Idempotent transaction logging that prevents accidental duplicate entries and transaction race conditions
Formula-protected interface that shields critical business logic from accidental edits by non-technical shop staff
Scalable database architecture structured to handle 10,000+ transaction records smoothly
Automated margin calculator that delivers accurate real-time profit analysis on every individual item sold
